prompt: It is 7:45 pm. What time will it be in 40 minutes?

weakest-single.text:
To find the time 40 minutes after 7:45 pm, we first add 40 minutes to 7:45 pm.

7:45 pm + 40 minutes = 8:45 pm

draft-raw.text:
To find the time in 40 minutes, add 40 minutes to the current time.

7:45 pm + 40 minutes = 8:25 pm

So, it will be 8:25 pm.
